plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco Nexus switches running NX-OS. Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects CPU and memory utilization (CISCO-SYSTEM-EXT-MIB) and power-supply / fan-tray operational state (CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB, names from ENTITY-MIB).
name: Switch

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of Cisco Nexus NX-OS (CISCO-SYSTEM-EXT-MIB cseSysCPUUtilization, Gauge32 0-100). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of Cisco Nexus NX-OS (CISCO-SYSTEM-EXT-MIB cseSysMemoryUtilization, Gauge32 0-100). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Cisco Nexus power supply (CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB cefcFRUPowerOperStatus, name from ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalName). Only ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalClass powerSupply(6) rows with a status are kept. Normalized to 1=normal / 2=abnormal: on(2) maps to 1; offAdmin(3) and failed/environmental-off states map to 2; undefined values are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Cisco Nexus fan tray (CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB cefcFanTrayOperStatus, name from ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalName). Normalized to 1=normal / 2=abnormal / 3=Unknown: up(2) maps to 1; down(3) and warning(4) map to 2; unknown(1) maps to 3 (gray, no alert); undefined values and rows without a status are dropped.
